1.explanation: To reproduce the bug, create a React component using the `MultiSelect` component from `carbon-components-react`. Define a list of items and set some of them as initially selected. Enable the `filterable` property. When you run this code and click on the `<input>` field of the multiselect, the focus outline will appear only around the input field instead of the entire multiselect control, demonstrating the bug.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs when a filterable multiselect component is used, and some options are selected. Clicking on the `<input>` field of the multiselect results in the focus outline being incorrectly placed around the `<input>` element instead of the entire control. This is visible in the provided images where the focus outline is only around the input field rather than the whole multiselect component.
